function.name: sports_ranking_get_top_ranked
function.description: Get the current top ranked athlete for a specific sport. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sport.description: The sport to get the ranking for.

year.description: The year for which the ranking is required.

message.content:
LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes in the history of the sport. Born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, he rose to prominence as a high‑school phenom at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School, where he was named the USA Today High School Player of the Year and led his team to a state championship.

He entered the NBA directly from high school in 2003, being selected first overall by the Cleveland Cavaliers. Over his career, LeBron has played for the Cleveland Cavaliers (two stints), the Miami Heat, and the Los Angeles Lakers. He has won four NBA championships (2009, 2010, 2012, 2013, 2020) and earned four NBA Most Valuable Player awards (2009, 2010, 2012, 2013). Known for his versatility, athleticism, court vision, and leadership, he has been selected to numerous All‑NBA teams and has represented the United States in international competition, winning Olympic gold medals in 2008, 2012, and 2016.

Beyond the court, LeBron is also a philanthropist, entrepreneur, and media personality. He founded the LeBron James Family Foundation, which focuses on education initiatives such as the opening of the “I Promise School” in Akron. He has produced and starred in films and television projects, including the critically acclaimed drama “Space Jam: A New Legacy.” His influence extends into business ventures, including ownership stakes in media companies and partnerships with major brands.
